import json, subprocess, sys, time, random, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def psize(obj, cap=20010):
    m.MAX_TUPLES = cap
    services = obj["services"]
    si = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(services)}
    atoms = m.collect_atoms(obj["rules"])
    mons = [m.build_monitor(op, p, si, len(services))[0] for op, p in atoms]
    res = m.build_product(mons, len(services))
    return (len(res[0]) if res else None)

def run(obj):
    obj = dict(obj); obj["queries"] = [["t%02d" % i for i in range(len(obj["services"]))]]
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=(json.dumps(obj)+"\n").encode(), capture_output=True)
    el = time.time()-t0
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    return out, el

rng = random.Random(17)
services = ["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)]

def randpath(rng, n, pool):
    return [rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(n)]

print("=== conjunction of contains ===")
for natoms in (5, 8, 10):
    pats = [randpath(rng, 16, services) for _ in range(natoms)]
    rules = [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "contains", "path": p} for p in pats]}}]
    obj = {"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": []}
    ps = psize(obj)
    out, el = run(obj)
    ms = len(out["dfa"]["accept"]) if out.get("ok") else out.get("error")
    print("natoms", natoms, "product", ps, "minimal", ms, "%.2fs" % el)

print("=== mixture: match/startswith/endswith/contains, and/or/not ===")
for trial in range(6):
    rules = []
    for a in range(10):
        op = rng.choice(["match", "startswith", "endswith", "contains"])
        path = randpath(rng, rng.randint(8, 16), services)
        e = {"op": op, "path": path}
        r = rng.random()
        if r < 0.3:
            e = {"op": "not", "arg": e}
        elif r < 0.6:
            e = {"op": rng.choice(["and", "or"]), "args": [e, {"op": "not", "arg": dict(e, path=randpath(rng, rng.randint(4, 12), services))}]}
        rules.append({"action": rng.choice(["allow", "drop"]), "when": e})
    obj = {"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": []}
    ps = psize(obj)
    if ps is None:
        out, el = run(obj)
        print("product >20010 ->", out.get("error"), "%.2fs" % el)
        continue
    out, el = run(obj)
    ms = len(out["dfa"]["accept"]) if out.get("ok") else out.get("error")
    print("product", ps, "minimal", ms, "%.2fs" % el)
